title: Nuclear architecture protein Distal antenna balances genome-binding and phase-separation properties to regulate neuroblast competence
authors: Gillie Benchorin; Maggie Jiaqi Li; Richard Jangwon Cho; Yuxin Hu; Minoree Kohwi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核结构蛋白Dan通过DNA结合域与相分离特性调控神经母细胞能力，涉及蛋白质-DNA互作与相分离机制，但非典型TF-DNA结合建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟，故评分为5。
abstract: Neural progenitors transit through multiple competence states that restrict production of each neural cell type. In Drosophila neuroblasts, a timed genome reorganization relocates the cell fate gene, hunchback , to the nuclear periphery, terminating competence to produce early-born neurons. Distal antenna (Dan), a pipsqueak (Psq) superfamily protein, is transiently downregulated at mid-embryogenesis, which is required for this relocation. Here we find that Dan is a highly intrinsically disordered protein, and when its Psq DNA-binding domain is increasingly disrupted, Dan coalesces into steadily larger, interconnected hubs of rapid protein exchange. Consistent with these phase-separation properties, Dan has a predicted LARKS domain, a structural motif that forms reversible interactions associated with phase-separation. In the embryo, loss of either the Psq motif or the LARKS domain abrogates Dan’s ability to maintain neuroblast early competence upon misexpression, suggesting that Dan requires both DNA-binding and phase-separation to regulate neuroblast competence. Finally, we found that Dan strongly interacts with proteins of the nuclear pore complex (NPC), and Elys, a core NPC scaffold protein known to regulate genome architecture, binds the hb intron and is required for competence termination. Together, the results support a model for how Dan’s phase-separation properties can mediate dynamic restructuring by balancing genome-binding, self-association, and interaction among nuclear architecture regulators.
abstract_zh: 神经祖细胞经历多个能力状态，这些状态限制了每种神经细胞类型的产生。在果蝇神经母细胞中，一次定时发生的基因组重组将细胞命运基因hunchback重新定位至核外周，从而终止产生早期出生神经元的能力。Distal antenna (Dan) 是一种pipsqueak (Psq) 超家族蛋白，在胚胎发生中期被瞬时下调，这一过程对于上述重组是必需的。在此，我们发现Dan是一种高度内在无序蛋白，当其Psq DNA结合域被逐渐破坏时，Dan会凝聚成逐渐增大、相互连接且具有快速蛋白质交换的枢纽。与这些相分离特性一致，Dan具有一个预测的LARKS结构域，这是一种与相分离相关的可逆相互作用的结构基序。在胚胎中，无论是Psq基序还是LARKS结构域的缺失，都会在过表达时废除Dan维持神经母细胞早期能力的功能，这表明Dan需要同时具备DNA结合和相分离能力来调控神经母细胞能力。最后，我们发现Dan与核孔复合体 (NPC) 蛋白强烈相互作用，而Elys（一种已知调控基因组结构的核心NPC支架蛋白）结合hb内含子，并且是能力终止所必需的。综合来看，这些结果支持一个模型，即Dan的相分离特性如何通过平衡基因组结合、自关联以及核结构调控因子之间的相互作用来介导动态重组。
